params.prompt: A young woman at night in her bedroom studio, wearing over-ear headphones, mid-sentence talking out loud with a relaxed half-smile, lit by a soft mint-green glow from off-camera and a cool blue window behind her. Intimate late-night conversation energy, like talking to a trusted friend. Vertical cinematic editorial photograph, shot on 35mm, shallow depth of field, moody dark graphite base tones with electric blue and a distinct mint-green accent light. Gen Z energy, real person, natural skin, candid and unposed, premium fashion-campaign quality. IMPORTANT COMPOSITION: the subject sits in the lower-left or lower-right third, leaving the top third and the center-right area as clean empty negative space for later text and a phone mockup overlay. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no watermarks, no logos, no brand marks, no screens showing charts or numbers, no phone visible in frame.
